question: What Salesforce editions support Sales Cloud Einstein and what is the licensing model?
expected_answer: Sales Cloud Einstein is available in Performance and Unlimited Editions at no extra cost, and for an extra cost in Enterprise Edition. It is not supported in Government Cloud or Government Cloud Plus orgs. Users need a standard Salesforce user license, and access is controlled through the Sales Cloud Einstein Included or Sales Cloud Included Bundle permission sets.
relevant_context: Available with Sales Cloud Einstein, which is available Performance and Unlimited Editions, and for an extra cost in Enterprise Edition<>Sales Cloud Einstein is available only to users with standard Salesforce licenses. Sales Cloud Einstein isn't supported in Government Cloud and Government Cloud Plus organizations.<>The Sales Cloud Einstein Included and Sales Cloud Included Bundle standard permission sets include the permissions for Sales Cloud Einstein features.

question: How many custom objects can I create in the Enterprise Edition, and can I use Customer Experience Intelligence with that edition?
expected_answer: In Enterprise Edition, you can create up to 200 custom objects (plus additional ones from managed packages up to a total of 3,000). Customer Experience Intelligence is available in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Editions, but it requires Data Cloud to be enabled and the Customer Exprc Intel add-on.
relevant_context: Custom objects: 200. The custom objects that are contained in a managed package that's publicly posted on AppExchange don't count against the allocations for your Salesforce edition. At the same time, an org can't have more than 3,000 custom objects.<>Available in: Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Editions with Data Cloud enabled and the Customer Exprc Intel add-on

question: What permissions are needed to enable Customer Experience Intelligence?
expected_answer: You need the Data Cloud Admin permission set AND the Scoring Framework Admin permission set. You must also first turn on Data Cloud before enabling Customer Experience Intelligence.
relevant_context: To enable Customer Experience Intelligence: Data Cloud Admin permission set AND Scoring Framework Admin permission set. To use Customer Experience Intelligence, first turn on Data Cloud.<>Enable Customer Experience Intelligence in Setup for insights into customer behaviors and preferences.

question: Can I use Salesforce on mobile devices, and are there any editions where mobile is not available?
expected_answer: Salesforce recommends using the Salesforce mobile app for working on mobile devices. Lightning Experience is available on multiple editions. However, in the Controlled Setting Edition, mobile features and mobile push are unavailable due to isolation restrictions. Salesforce Classic also does not support mobile browsers.
relevant_context: Supported Browsers and Devices for Lightning Experience: Lightning Experience is available on multiple editions and recommends using the Salesforce mobile app on mobile devices.<>Supported Browsers and Devices for Salesforce Classic: Salesforce Classic doesn't support mobile browsers, so we recommend using the Salesforce mobile app for working on mobile devices.<>Mobile Features: Mobile is unavailable. Mobile Push: Mobile push is unavailable.

question: What is the maximum number of custom fields per object across different Salesforce editions?
expected_answer: The limits vary by edition: Personal Edition allows 5, Starter Edition allows 25, Contact Manager allows 25, Group Edition allows 100, Pro Suite allows 100, Professional Edition allows 100, Enterprise Edition allows 500, Developer Edition allows 500, and Unlimited Edition allows 800. Regardless of edition, an org cannot have more than 900 custom fields on most object types including fields from managed packages.
